mainEntity.name: When is the best time to do trim and detail painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim and detail painting can be done at any time of year, as it's typically an interior project. However, it's often a good idea to coordinate it with other interior painting projects or during a general home refresh to minimize disruption. We work year-round and can schedule your project at your convenience.
